nodes.name: js-cache-storage.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card advising caching the results of repeated or expensive Storage/API calls (e.g. localStorage reads) instead of re-invoking them on every access.

nodes.name: js-combine-iterations.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending combining multiple sequential array iterations (map/filter/forEach chains) into a single pass to reduce redundant traversal overhead.

nodes.name: js-early-exit.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card promoting early returns / guard clauses in functions to avoid deep nesting and unnecessary computation.

nodes.name: js-hoist-regexp.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card advising that RegExp literals be hoisted out of hot loops or render functions instead of being recreated on every call.

nodes.name: js-index-maps.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending building a Map/object index for repeated lookups instead of scanning arrays with find()/indexOf() each time.

nodes.name: js-length-check-first.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card advising an early array-length comparison before element-by-element equality checks to short-circuit obviously unequal arrays.

nodes.name: js-min-max-loop.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending a single linear-scan loop to find min/max values instead of sorting the entire array, reducing complexity from O(n log n) to O(n).

nodes.name: js-set-map-lookups.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card advising the use of Set/Map for O(1) membership lookups instead of Array.includes()/indexOf(), which are O(n).

nodes.name: js-tosorted-immutable.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending the immutable toSorted() array method over the mutating sort() to avoid unintended side effects on shared array references.

nodes.name: rendering-activity.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending React's Activity component to show/hide subtrees while preserving component state, instead of unmounting and remounting.

nodes.name: rendering-animate-svg-wrapper.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card advising that animations target a wrapping element's transform rather than animating SVG element attributes directly, for smoother rendering performance.

nodes.name: rendering-conditional-render.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending explicit ternary/boolean conditional rendering in JSX instead of `&&` short-circuiting, which can accidentally render falsy values like 0.

nodes.name: rendering-content-visibility.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending the CSS content-visibility property to skip rendering work for off-screen items in long lists.

nodes.name: rendering-hoist-jsx.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card advising that static JSX elements not dependent on props or state be hoisted outside the component function to avoid recreation on every render.

nodes.name: rendering-hydration-no-flicker.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card describing a technique for handling client/server hydration mismatches without a visible flicker after hydration completes.

nodes.name: rendering-hydration-suppress-warning.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending suppressHydrationWarning for intentionally expected server/client rendering mismatches, such as timestamps.

nodes.name: rendering-svg-precision.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending reduced decimal precision in SVG path and attribute values to shrink markup size and improve rendering efficiency.

nodes.name: rendering-usetransition-loading.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending React's useTransition hook over manually managed isLoading state for smoother, non-blocking UI updates.

nodes.name: rerender-defer-reads.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card advising that state or context reads be deferred to the point of usage rather than destructured early, to limit unnecessary re-render scope.

nodes.name: rerender-dependencies.md
nodes.summary: Best-practice rule card recommending narrow, precise dependency arrays for useEffect/useMemo/useCallback to avoid unnecessary re-executions.
